args.title: Saltmarsh Foods Newsletter Summary – Retail Returns Logistics
args.body:
- Newsletter (Retail returns logistics): Highlights rising apparel return rates (24%) and growing adoption of consolidated return hubs as a key industry trend.
- Linked article: Reports that apparel return rates have hit 24%, and that consolidating returns into dedicated hubs cuts handling costs by roughly one-fifth (20%).
- Companion piece: Finds that reselling returned items within a 10-day window preserves most of the product's original margin, reinforcing the case for faster returns processing.
